description: Lists published items of one post type, newest first by default, with optional filters. Returns summaries (title, URL, dates, excerpt). Use get_post for the full content.

after.description: Only items published after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601)

before.description: Only items published before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601)

include_acf.description: Include shortened ACF fields for each item (useful when content lives in ACF)

modified_after.description: Only items last modified after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601); finds recent edits

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy slug to filter by, e.g. "category" or "post_tag"

terms.description: Term slugs or numeric IDs in that taxonomy. Requires taxonomy.

name: list_posts
title: List posts, pages, or custom posts
